# Rust dependency licenses

This file contains the license and copyright texts for Rust crates in the
locked AutoPierCam workspace's normal dependency graph for
`x86_64-pc-windows-msvc`. Build-only, development-only, and non-Windows target
dependencies are excluded by `about.toml`.

The report is generated by `cargo-about 0.9.1`; do not edit it by hand.
Regeneration instructions are in `README.md` in this directory.
